rule_random_ok.what: the choosing rule: bar 3's random_ok (K learnable candidates at random, seeded by the run's seed and the level) instead of lpca

rule_rca.what: the choosing rule: lpca's concepts and bindings, the concepts taken in a random order (seeded by the run's seed and the level) instead of hardest first

rule_lpcc.what: the choosing rule: lpca's concepts, hardest first, each practised in every binding tied for cheapest instead of cleanest

rule_ct1.what: the choosing rule: bar 3's ct1 (the round searched with each learnable candidate alone as a routine; the K that shorten it most, ties in pool order) instead of lpca

rule_nov.what: the choosing rule: bar 3's novelty (on the target's inputs, the rows' N and x at full size as the round starts: the rows where a candidate's A differs from every token's; the K most novel, ties in pool order) instead of lpca

book_min.what: the smallest book the leave-one-out arms allow: laws lt, red, add, mul, acc.mul on patterns pair, x+on, x,o, o,x,d

book_gen.what: the book generated by a grammar (integration/sp_ablation/genbook.py): numbers by the division law's form, every operation on every pattern, one set of target rules
